title: Chapter 99: Silently Looking at You
html:
The hurried footsteps belonged to someone fleeing a monster. When Chen Ge stepped from the classroom, he saw the six-foot Zhu Jianing burst from the girls’ dormitory, screaming for his life. His face had gone white, and he charged down the corridor like a maddened bull.

What happened? He must have encountered something in the girls’ dormitory, but there’s nothing frightening in those rooms.Zhu Jianing had lost his mind with fear before Chen Ge did anything. The sight left him almost disappointed.

Didn’t they claim nothing frightened them? They were so calm when they entered, so why is he tearing through the place like a rabid dog?Chen Ge did not know what they had encountered in the new scenario. For safety’s sake, he decided to intercept Zhu Jianing and find out.

Zhu Jianing had barely escaped the girls’ bedroom when a shadow moved inside the sealed classroom.

The uniforms came alive?!The thought flashed through his mind. Moving too fast to stop, he reached the classroom just as a bloodstained shadow slipped out. Time slowed. His gaze fixed on a face stitched from many others, each fragment frozen in fear, terror, and pain.

I knew that classroom wasn’t safe!Unable to stop, Zhu Jianing slammed into the corridor wall. Pain shot through him, but he shoved himself away and fled.

Pain and terror scrambled his thoughts. Without looking, Zhu Jianing dashed through the first doorway he saw and found himself inside the corner restroom.

Why would he trap himself?Chen Ge’s curiosity about whatever the man had encountered in the girls’ bedroom deepened. And why is he alone? Where’s his friend?

Chen Ge decided the simplest solution was to ask the man directly. He adjusted the skin mask and entered. Only then did Zhu Jianing realize he had trapped himself, but it was too late. He yanked open the fourth cubicle and hid inside.

He clamped a hand over his mouth and wedged his muscular body beside the toilet, heart hammering, eyes darting. During the Pen Spirit game, he had sat across from Fei Youliang. While his friend lectured, Zhu Jianing had watched the spirit slowly materialize behind him. The memory of the woman’s bloated face sucked the air from his lungs.

That wasn’t an actor! This Haunted House is really haunted!They had searched every inch of the bedroom, even beneath the bed, before starting the game. No one had been hiding there. The dead woman had appeared from nowhere.

It had to be a ghost!The woman’s face would not leave his mind. Even with his eyes closed, he saw her swaying from the rope. He pressed helplessly against the wall, horribly exposed.

Youliang is still in there. The ghost was standing on his shoulders. That couldn’t happen in real life… could it?Zhu Jianing gulped several breaths, already light-headed from panic.

I need to contact the others. Something is wrong with this Haunted House.He told himself not to be afraid, but his powerful arms would not stop trembling. After fumbling through his backpack, he found his phone.

“Xiao Zhu? Why are you calling me? Are you guys done with the video?” The squat middle-aged man’s voice came from the other end.

“Brother Yuan, please come help me! There are real ghosts in this Haunted House!” Zhu Jianing’s tearful voice trembled. “I don’t know how much longer I can hold on. God knows how many of them are looking for me.”

“Isn’t it normal for a Haunted House to have ghosts?” The man assumed he was joking.

“Not actors—actual ghosts!” Zhu Jianing hissed, afraid to raise his voice lest the things outside hear him.

The middle-aged man finally noticed the seriousness in Zhu Jianing’s voice. “Give the phone to Youliang, let me talk to him.”

“Brother Liang was possessed. He’s still trapped in that cursed bedroom.”

“Possessed?”

“I saw it! The ghost was standing on his shoulders. A hanged woman with a purple-white face and eyes bulging from their sockets!”

“Standing on his shoulders? You guys were assaulted by the workers? Okay! We’re going in now!”

“Not the workers—a real ghost! There aren’t any workers inside…” Before Zhu Jianing could finish, footsteps sounded at the restroom entrance. “Did it come in here?!”

“What are you talking about? Hello?” The middle-aged man’s voice came from the phone. Afraid that it might catch the ghost’s attention, Zhu Jianing quickly ended the call.

Please don’t hear me. Don’t find me, and I swear I’ll never come back.Zhu Jianing silenced his phone, crouched beside the toilet, and stared at the cubicle door.

At any moment, the door might be torn open—and he had no idea what would stand beyond it. Horrific images crowded his mind: the woman’s face peering over the door, an empty school uniform drifting into the cubicle.

What should I do? Brother Yuan, please come soon!he prayed to himself. The sound of footsteps came closer and closer!

CREAK…

The first cubicle opened. Its old wooden door groaned, and Zhu Jianing held his breath. After a short pause, the second door swung open.

It’s getting closer!After another long pause, as he expected, the third door was pushed open.

It’s right beside me! My door is next!Every muscle in Zhu Jianing’s body tightened. Terror gnawed at his sanity. Seconds crawled past, yet his door did not move. Half a minute passed. Still nothing.

It left?He gathered all his courage to pull open the door a sliver. There was nothing outside. It really left?

He slowly pushed the door wider. No one stood outside. I got lucky. It almost found me.

Breathing out in relief, Zhu Jianing called the middle-aged man again. The glow of his screen revealed a reflection. He turned. Above the third cubicle door, a disjointed face silently watched him.
